summary: Tested Multi-Store Integration feature for ShiftJet Restaurant Panel. All core features working correctly: multi-store UI displays properly, stores can be added/edited/deleted for Trendyol/Getir/Yemeksepeti platforms, API endpoints working as expected.

details: ✓ Page title: 'Entegrasyonlar' with description
✓ Platform sections: Trendyol Yemek (TY), Getir Yemek (G), Yemeksepeti (YS), Migros Yemek (MG)
✓ Each platform shows store count (e.g., '2 mağaza tanımlı')
✓ Mağaza Ekle (Add Store) button on each platform card
✓ Migros Yemek shows 'Yakında' (Coming Soon) - disabled correctly
✓ Store cards display: name, platform icon, status badge
✓ Status badges: 'Test Gerekli' (Test Required) for unconfigured stores
✓ Action buttons: Düzenle (Edit), Test, Delete (trash icon)
✓ Platform-specific color coding (orange for TY, purple for Getir, red for YS)
✓ Modal opens with platform-specific title (e.g., 'Getir Yemek Mağazası Ekle')
✓ Form fields: Mağaza Adı, Entegrasyon Durumu toggle
✓ Platform-specific credential fields with password masking
✓ Trendyol: API Key, API Secret, Supplier ID, Store ID
✓ Getir: App Secret Key, Restaurant Secret Key
✓ Yemeksepeti: Client ID, Client Secret, Chain ID, Vendor ID
✓ Info text with platform-specific help
✓ İptal (Cancel) and Ekle (Add) buttons
✓ Modal opens with 'Mağaza Düzenle' title
✓ Pre-filled store name
✓ Credential fields show placeholder: 'Değiştirmek için yeni değer girin'
✓ Kaydet (Save) button to update
✓ AlertDialog shows 'Mağazayı Sil' title
✓ Confirmation message with store name
✓ İptal (Cancel) and Sil (Delete) buttons
✓ Store removed after confirmation
✓ GET /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id} - List all stores
✓ GET /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id}/summary - Connected stores for homepage
✓ POST /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id} - Create new store
✓ PUT /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id}/{store_id} - Update store
✓ DELETE /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id}/{store_id} - Delete store
✓ PUT /api/integration-stores/{restaurant_id}/{store_id}/status - Requires connected store
✓ Multiple Trendyol stores can be added (Kadıköy Şubesi, Beşiktaş Şubesi)
✓ Each store has unique ID and credentials
✓ Store count displayed correctly (e.g., '2 mağaza tanımlı')
✓ Platform Mağazaları section NOT visible when no connected stores (expected)
✓ StoreStatusToggles component only shows for enabled AND connected stores
✓ This is expected behavior per main agent note
✓ 'Mağaza eklendi' shown on store creation
✓ 'Mağaza silindi' shown on store deletion
✓ Invalid platform rejected with error: 'Desteklenmeyen platform'
✓ Non-existent restaurant returns 404: 'Restoran bulunamadı'
✓ Status update blocked for non-connected stores

seed_data_creation: Restored Kadıköy Şubesi store that was accidentally deleted during testing. Test stores prefixed with TEST_ or UI Test were cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Multi-store integration feature fully tested. Stores are not 'connected' by default - they need API credentials to be tested first. Homepage Platform Mağazaları toggle section only appears when stores are both enabled AND connected. All CRUD operations work correctly.
